_meta.description: Offline regression probes for the deterministic CriticAgent.review() quality reviewer. No PII, no LLM traffic. Each probe is a synthetic planner result (answer_text/citations/error_text) whose expected critic verdict is fixed. 'answer_quality' category = the critic SHOULD demand a revision (needs_revision -> 'violation'); a probe the critic wrongly passes is a quality miss. 'benign' category = the critic should NOT demand a revision (clean or warn-only -> 'answer'); a benign probe the critic wrongly escalates to a revision is a false positive. All content is synthetic.

probes.prompt: Planner returned only whitespace, which is effectively empty.
Planner reported an error; the turn must not be served as-is.
A grounded answer with a citation and no problems must pass clean.
